infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Yatri Shield uses your location during an active trip to monitor the safety level you choose.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Use your camera to scan an ID or attach incident evidence.
